name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown menu
description: A button that opens a short list of actions or choices on the #171717 overlay surface: a neutral hairline, the brand corner, rows that take a #262626 fill under the pointer. Arrows, Home, End, Escape and Tab are handled.
use_for: A creative's actions, a sort order, account actions: a handful of choices that don't need to stay on screen. Radio rows for one choice from a few.
never: Writing your own outside-click or arrow handling
A shadow under the panel: the hairline and the #171717 fill set it apart
A spectrum color for a row or its marker
Two or three views of one thing (use tabs)
source: Derived from the guidelines: the #171717 card fill on Black, neutral hairlines, the 10px canvas corner (8px here), DM Sans 14px rows and capital labels at 6%. shadcn's dropdown menu for anatomy and keys.
body:
`MenuItem`, `MenuLabel` and `MenuSeparator` are the rows of every menu here (the context menu uses them too); they are
also exported under shadcn's names (`DropdownMenuItem`, `DropdownMenuLabel`, `DropdownMenuSeparator`).

examples.name: Actions
examples.label: A creative's actions

) }
